profile.summary: I enjoy problem solving. Feel free to contact me at brijeshp@ripple.com.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: IAM at Ripple Prime - a single-counterparty, multi-asset prime broker across digital and traditional asset classes.

positions.title: Technical Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Go, GCP FHIR, Auth0, RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC + CIAM, OAuth/OIDC + JWT, SCIM, Open Policy Agent (OPA) + Rego, SSO + MFA, Email/SMS OTP, Account Linking, Fraud Detection, Multi-Tenancy, Tenant Migrations

All things CIAM, identity governance, and access control. Modernized Grant framework to authenticate/authorize diverse principals (Human / Group / Machine / Agentic Identities). Architected fine-grained authorization models via RBAC and ReBAC with Open Policy Agent (OPA/Rego). Designed scalable multi-tenancy, zero-downtime tenant migrations, automated enterprise provisioning (SCIM), and custom MCP + GCP Apigee integrations for AI Agents.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Go, Rust, NVIDIA GPU Encoding, RMF, Threat Modeling, Software Change Management (SCRs), HIPAA

Surgical Assistant ML model integration (video ingestion --> frame-by-frame inference --> de-noise / normalize --> GUI overlay) + NVIDIA GPU Encoding. Rust Microservices.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Rust, Go, Bash, GCP KMS, Linux Security (UEFI Secure Boot + TPM 2.0, LUKS, SSH + Cloud PKI + Ephemeral servicing credentials, Uncomplicated Firewalls (UFW), DMA security, mkosi for Linux OS Image generation), SaMD (Software as a Medical Device), mTLS

Security for Surgical AI Assistant Linux Box deployed in Surgical Operating Rooms.

Development and support for the world's first full-body primate scanner.

projects.title: Classifying White Blood Cells to Aid Diagnosis of Autoimmune Diseases - CS 231N
projects.description: •	Compared various convolutional neural network architectures (ResNet-50, ResNet-18, VGG-16, custom model) and preprocessing strategies to classify four different types of white blood cells from a Kaggle dataset (CNNs, Google Cloud, TensorFlow, Keras, NumPy).

projects.title: News Categorization - CS 221
projects.description:
•	Predict the category for a news article based on its headline and a short description (NLP, RNNs, A.I.).
•	Supervised learning approach with a bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) and GLOVE word embeddings.
•	Cost sensitive learning (created a custom loss function), implemented to better learn on an imbalanced dataset.
